items.text: An MBA in finance leads to corporate finance, banking, credit, investments and treasury roles, and the path you get depends less on the degree title than on the college, your internships, your modelling proof and the function you pick first.
Choose the finance function first, check recent roles from the college and build a model before the course starts.
Check official pages and ask alumni about their actual first roles.
